## Checklist

- [ ] A test fails without this change and passes with it
- [ ] `./scripts/test.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Documentation is updated (and `mkdocs build --strict` passes for docs changes)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] If simulation results change for any seed or map, the entry says which
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data are included
